payment_date_note: The sheet has a payment-year label and footnote deadlines ('не позднее') for nominee holders and other holders. Those are not a single payment date and are not stored.
period_end_note: period_end is the calendar end of the results-period label (FY 31 Dec, M9 30 Sep). The payment-year column is not period_end. Undistributed-profit rows have no period_end.
published_at_note: No disclosure timestamp. An AGM date inside one period sentence is kept as shareholder_approval_date and is not published_at, payment_date, or period_end.
